content.description_seo: Tampa Livestream Pros is a Tampa, Florida videography team offering live streaming for weddings alongside corporate events, funerals, and sports. Coverage ranges from a single-camera setup to a full multi-camera production with a sound desk and live graphics, streamed to platforms like Facebook, YouTube, Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams, or hosted on a private link. For weddings specifically, the company can run a concurrent Zoom session so remote guests are able to participate in the ceremony rather than only watch, and footage is preserved on Vimeo for the couple after the event.
content.one_line_summary: Tampa-based multi-event livestream company (weddings, corporate, funerals, sports) offering 1-5 camera setups and optional concurrent Zoom guest participation.

faq_items.a_summary: Ranges from a simple 1-camera stream to a full 3-5 camera setup with a sound desk and live graphics; a unique URL (public or private) is provided.
Varies by event size, camera count, duration, and complexity — quote-only, no published price list.

faq_items.q: What happens to the video after the event?
faq_items.a_summary: Saved to a Vimeo link; can be edited/updated afterward; the client retains ownership.
